summary: Iteration 2 tested new features: bill CRUD, recurring generator, savings recommendation, Claude Sonnet 4-6 AI advice, calendar grid UI, bill editor, and paycheck detail sheets. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed (including live AI call). Frontend: calendar renders with paycheck-colored cells, + button opens bill editor, simple + recurring bill creation both work, savings sheet applies transfer, AI sheet returns valid Claude response with priority_order & summary, add-bill-inline navigates correctly. No red screens. Notifications correctly no-op on web (expected).

issues: Bottom tab still labeled 'Bills' but screen header is 'Calendar' — carry-over from iteration_1 note, not blocking.

action_items: Optional: rename Bills tab label to 'Calendar' for naming consistency.
Optional: /api/paychecks/{id}/ai-advice takes ~10-20s; consider adding a request-side timeout hint or streaming for UX.

Optional: recurring generator silently skips occurrences when no paycheck exists for the target date (e.g., extending far beyond seeded months). Consider returning skipped_count in the response so UI can warn users.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan in a future iteration.
expo-notifications: web warning 'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' is benign but noisy; safe to ignore for web preview.
notifications.ts correctly guards Platform.OS === 'web' → no-op; only device builds will schedule.
Bill editor uses api.listBills().find(id) for edit prefill — works, but a GET /api/bills/{id} endpoint would be cleaner and cheaper for large datasets.
seed_data_creation: No new seed. Test bills created + deleted via API. UI-created TEST_UI_* bills cleaned up post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_bills_and_ai.py (bills CRUD, recurring generator, savings-rec, ai-advice, regression). Also /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from iter1. Frontend key testIDs: calendar-screen, add-bill-btn, calendar-month-{key}, day-{n}, cal-paycheck-{id}, bill-editor, input-name, input-amount, input-due, seg-cat-{cat}, seg-rec-{rec}, input-occurrences, notif-toggle, save-bill, generate-bills, delete-bill, paycheck-detail, ai-advice-btn, savings-btn, ai-sheet, savings-sheet, rec-conservative/balanced/aggressive, add-bill-inline, detail-bill-{id}. AI endpoint uses claude-sonnet-4-6 via emergentintegrations + EMERGENT_LLM_KEY; typical latency 10-20s.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues. All requested endpoints and flows verified functional end-to-end.
